# Zynq-7000 build

* `build.tcl`: Vivado script that builds the block design (processing system
  + `rtl/zynq/ap_zynq.v`), the bitstream and the `.xsa` for Vitis.
* `host/`: bare-metal host program for the Cortex-A9.
  * `main.c`: loads and runs the RISC-V programs, compares the benchmark
    against the ARM.
  * `ap_regs.h`: register map of the host interface.
  * `ap_programs.h`: the RISC-V program images, generated by
    `make -C sw zynq`.

Step-by-step instructions: [docs/zynq.md](../../docs/zynq.md).
